title: Sigil and Wolf Anew
author: J. M. Pemberton
blurb: Isandro Okonkwo, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
